purpose: Replace the quality-passing but speed-failing 32,768-token global output head with a small train-only base head unioned at runtime with token IDs already present in the current prompt. This targets the measured grounding/rewriting copy bottleneck without validation leakage.

exact_quantized_weight_reuse.quantized_selected_logits_definition: The graph gathers allowed rows from the existing full int8 input embedding, transposes them, and reuses the original DynamicQuantizeLinear/MatMulInteger scaling path. For every admitted global ID, its quantized projection column and scale are byte-identical to the original full head.

allowed_runtime_candidates.prompt_union: Unique authoritative tokenizer IDs present in the current prompt, including its locked trailing newline.
forbidden: domain packages not activated for the request
allowed_runtime_candidates.global_token_accounting: The ONNX local logit index must map back to the exact global tokenizer ID before repetition controls, decoding, evidence, or token counting.

nested_base_budgets.construction: previous plus every token occurring in search-only ABI English responses or locked general-English train responses

selection_rule.minimum_claim: The lowest passing tested base budget paired with the largest lower failing base budget, never a global minimum.
quality_gates: at least 95 percent sealed-parent top-1 agreement over 43,089 held-out general response tokens
performance_gates: median and paired-bootstrap-lower throughput at least 2x optimized Qwen
at least 95 percent sealed Phase 2 parent throughput
selection_rule.runtime_lock: 16 unrestricted ONNX intra-op threads, chosen from parent-only profiling before any dynamic candidate timing.

physical_proof_required: full duplicate output projection initializers absent
allowed_output_ids is a real ONNX graph input
embedding rows and scales are gathered by allowed_output_ids
canonical ABI output and one-route sparse cake execution unchanged
